_comment: LoopStar chord dictionary. Movable shapes as fret OFFSETS from the ANCHOR note (the lowest fretted string); anchorInterval is that note's semitones above the chord root, so rootless and inverted grips are templates too. null = muted. kind: full = 4+ notes, shell = 3. openShapes are POSITION-SPECIFIC grips at the nut, keyed by root pitch class, as absolute frets -- a shape ringing open strings between fretted ones cannot be a movable template. GENERATED by scripts/loopstar/build_chord_dictionary.py and verified against an explicit interval table; re-run it rather than hand-editing, and run scripts/loopstar/verify_guitar_voicings.py after any change -- a mistyped offset is a silently wrong chord.
_attribution: Movable shape patterns were identified by frequency analysis of chords-db (https://github.com/tombatossals/chords-db), MIT licensed, Copyright (c) 2016 David Rubert. Shapes are re-derived and verified against LoopStar's own interval table; chords-db is never read at runtime.
